title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring

code_status: Official repository exposes HunyuanVideo evaluation script scripts/run_hunyuan.sh; code and models were not executed.

reading_scope.main: Methods pp.2-3 Algorithm 1; experiments pp.3-8, especially video generation pp.4-6 Fig.3 and Table4; pattern/stride/threshold ablations Tables7-10; conclusion and impact p.9
reading_scope.appendix: Appendix A p.13 Wan2.1 results Table11; Appendix B p.13 language-model generalization Table12 checked
reading_scope.limits: No code/model execution, no independent video evaluation, no exhaustive bibliography or proof audit

key_evidence: pp.2-3: strided antidiagonal proxy and cumulative-threshold block selection; head-specific threshold prediction optional
p.5: HunyuanVideo, 946 VBench prompts, same seed/prompt dense-reference comparison; 720x1280, 129 frames, 50 denoising steps; first 5 dense steps reduce layout differences
p.6 Table4: threshold 0.95 yields PSNR23.5 SSIM0.822 LPIPS0.155 density45.5%; similarity metrics, not semantic correctness or full VBench quality score
p.7 Table8: stride64 has worse prediction/accuracy than small strides; coverage claim is not a guarantee on arbitrary patterns
p.6 section3.3 and p.7 Fig4: 13.5x refers to attention prefill at256K tokens; language end-to-end results are Table6, not video end-to-end latency
p.13 Table11: Wan2.1 density falls39.2 to33.6 as threshold rises0.90 to0.95, opposite its higher-density caption; rendered and visually verified
